evidence: Zr-silicate films were deposited directly on Si (100) substrates at 400°C by CVD. The wafers used were a (100)-oriented p-type Si with a resistivity of 8-10 V cm. Immediately prior to deposition, wafers were dipped in HF:H2O 1:7 solution for 30 s and rinsed with deionized (DI) water to remove any native oxide layers.
